kataveditā.p: [Katavedī+tā] (thī) CL=7 One who knows or understands the appreciativeness. Understands gratitude (understands the appreciation of a person who is kind to him).
a: ကတဝေဒိတာ(ထီ)

B:
kataveditā： kataveditā（thī）
ကတဝေဒိတာ（ထီ）
[katavedī+tā]
[ကတဝေဒီ+တာ]
K:
kataveditā：ကတဝေဒိတာ （ထီ）
[ကတဝေဒီ+တာ]
ပြုဖူးသော ကျေးဇူးကို သိတတ်သောသူ၏အဖြစ်၊ ပြုဖူးသောကျေးဇူးကို အထူးသိခြင်း။
R:
kataveditā：ကတ-ဝေဒိ-တာ （ဣ）
ပြုအပ်ပြီးသော သူ့ကျေးဇူးကို သိတတ်သည်၏ အဖြစ်။
CPD: kata-vedi-tā , f. [ abstr. < katavedi(n) + tā], the fact of acknowledging a ( good ) deed ( that has been done to one ) : gratefulness; siyā kho bhikkhave tasmiṃ jarasiṅgāle yā kāci kataññutā ~ā. na tv' eva idh' ekacce sakya- puttiyapaṭiññe pi yā kāci kataññutā ~ā, S ll 272, 16,17 (= katavisesajānanaṃ, Spk ll 232, 2 ; ~ā ti tass' eva paresaṃ pākaṭikaraṇavasena jānanam eva, Spk-pṭ ll 193, 7 ); sabbhi h' etaṃ bhikkhave upaññātaṃ yad- idaṃ kataññutā ~ā, kevalā esā bhikkhave sappuri- sabhūmi yadidaṃ kataññutā ~ā ti, A l 61, 26,27 ; ka- taññutaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante ~aṃ sampassamāno Bhagavati evarūpaṃ paramanipaccākāraṃ karomi, V 66, 4 ; Pj l 34, 22 = lt-a ll 57, 1 ; — ifc. a -°; kataññū- ° (Ja ll 26, 3 ).

katavedī.p: [Kabha+vida+ṇī] (ti) CL=7 (A) One who completely understands appreciation or gratitude. (B) One who admits and enjoys appreciation to him. (C) One who repays a kind of deed (or) one who does a good deed in return.

B:
katavedī： katavedī（ti）
ကတဝေဒီ（တိ）
[kabha+vida+ṇī]
[ကဘ+ဝိဒ+ဏီ]
K:
katavedī：ကတဝေဒီ （တိ）
[ကဘ+ဝိဒ+ဏီ]
（က） ပြုခဲ့ဖူးသောကျေးဇူးကို （ထင်စွာပြု၍） သိတတ်သော၊ သူ။ （ခ） ပြုခဲ့ဖူးသော ကျေးဇူးကို နှစ်သက်တယ်-ခံစားတတ်-ဝန်ခံတတ်-သော၊ သူ။ （ဂ） ပြုခဲ့ဖူးသော ကျေးဇူးကို တုန့်ပြန်၍- ကျေးဇူးဆပ်တတ်-သိတတ်-သော၊ သူ။
R:
katavedī：ကတ-ဝေဒီ （တိ）
ပြုအပ်ပြီးသော သူ့ကျေးဇူးကို သိတတ်သည်။

katāvakāsa.cp: adj (= katokāsa); being permitted, given leave to, opportunity.
katāvakāsa.p: [Kata+avakāsa] (ti) CL=7 One who accepted permission.

B:
katāvakāsa： katāvakāsa（ti）
ကတာဝကာသ（တိ）
[kata+avakāsa]
[ကတ+အဝကာသ]

katāvakāsa：ကတာဝကာသ （တိ）
[ကတ+အဝကာသ]
ပြုအပ်ပြီးသော အခွင့်ရှိသော၊ အခွင့်ရပြီးသော၊ သူ။
R:
katāvakāsa：ကတာဝကာသ （တိ） （ကတ+အဝကာသ）
ပြုအပ်ပြီးသော အခွင့် ရှိသည်။
CPD: katâvakāsa , mfn. [kata + ava°; cf. katokāsa, q.v. ], 1.a. ( bhvr. ) obtained permission ( by somebody to ask a question; with instr. ) ; b. granted opportunity; 2. ( bhvr. ) one to whom somebody has conceded ( to do something; with instr. [ or. gen. ?; cf. Rem. , q.v. infra ] of the one making the concession and gen. [ or dat. ? - dat. of the goal, syntactically equivalent to an inf. ] of the thing conceded ) ; for a similar kind of cpd., cf. kataparittāṇa, q.v. — 1.a. Bāvarissa ca tuyhaṃ vā sabbesaṃ sabba- saṃsayaṃ ~ā pucchavho, Sn 1030; ~ā pucchantu bhonto yaṃ kiñci pañhaṃ manasâbhipatthitaṃ, Ja V 140, 26* qu. Ps ll 275, 2* ; ~o puccha ssu yaṃ kiñci abhipatthitan ti, D ll 240, 22,24 ; ~o kho bhavaṃ samaṇena Gotamena, M ll 142, 21 ; 143, 14* foll.; A lll 59, 20 ; atha kho Milindo rājā ~o ... etad avoca, Mil 95, 8 ; lt-a ll 111, 27 ; — 1.b. ~ā [kata]kusalā (kata has to be deleted m.c. as in Ce 1915) ito cutā sayaṃpabhā anuvicaranti Nandanaṃ, A lll 40, 21* (~ā [so read with v.l; Ee. katāvāsā] ti yena kammena tattha āvāso [ v.l. avakāso] hoti, tassa katattā ~ā ( so read with v.l.; Ee katâvāsā), Mp lll 249, 17 ) ≠ Vv 212 foll. ( = nipphā- ditasucaritâvakāsā, Vv-a 113, 27 ); — 2. ~o kho 'mhi bhagavatā dhammadesanāyā ti, Vin l 7, 8 ("bhaga- vat has conceded to me to teach the dhamma"; cf. H. Oldenberg, Reden des Buddha, 1922: 41) = M l 169, 28 qu. Bv-a 18, 19 ≠ S l 138, 26 ( reading bhagavato for bhagavatā) ≠ D ll 39, 25 ( reading: Vipassinā bhagava- tā arahatā sammāsambuddhena); — Rem.: this pas- sage is translated by l. B. Horner ( following other translators ), BD lV: 10: "The opportunity was made by me for the Lord to teach dhamma", in spite of the fact that it is both grammatically impossible and contextually unlikely; the reading bhagavato at S l 138, 26 , however, would seem to represent a reinterpretation of the clause supporting the traditional interpretation of the passage, unless the gen. is taken as the gen. of the agent to be construed with kata°; cf. Mvu lll 319, 8 : bhagavatā mahābrahmaṇe avakāśe kṛte, which would seem to support the interpretation suggested above.
NCP: mfn. | kataavakaasa having been given the opportunity; having been given consent; having obtained a chance or scope See also: kata

katāvī.p: [Kara+tāvī] (ti) CL=7 One who has done. (1) One who has practiced (some skill). (2) One who attained (four factors of Magga).

B:
katāvī： katāvī（ti）
ကတာဝီ（တိ）
[kara+tāvī]
[ကရ+တာဝီ]

katāvī：ကတာဝီ （တိ）
[ကရ+တာဝီ]
ပြုပြီးသော၊ သူ။ （၁） သင်အပ်-လေ့လာအပ်-ပြီးသော-အတတ်ရှိသော၊ အတတ်ကို သင်ပြီး，လေ့လာပြီးသော၊ သူ။ （၂） （လေးပါးသော မဂ်တို့ဖြင့်） ပြုအပ်ပြီးသော ကိစ္စရှိသော၊ （မဂ်ကိစ္စကို） ပြုပြီးသော （ရဟန္တာ）။
R:
katāvī：ကတာဝီ （တိ）
သင်အပ်ပြီးသော အတတ် ရှိသည်။ ကျွမ်းကျင်သည်။
DOP: katāvi(n) m ( fn ). [kata + (ā)vi(n); BHS kṛtāvin], one who has done (what was to be done); skilled, accomplished ; M II 69, 7 (hatthismiṃ pi ~ī assasmiṃ pi ~ī; Ps III 307, 1 : ~ī ti katakaraṇīyo sikkhitasikkho paguṇasippo); S I 14, 10* (yo hoti bhikkhu arahaṃ ~ī; Spk I 51, 13: ~ī ti catuhi dhammehi katakicco); Ap 461, 10 (akuho ~ī isi sattamo); 468, 17 (sāvakassa ~ino); Mil 264, 14 (puriso rājūpasevī ~ī); — °(ī)- bhūmi , f. , the condition or plane of one who has done (what was to be done) ; Peṭ 130, 16 (yaṃ avijjāvirāgā vimuccati, ayaṃ ~i arahattaṃ ca, so read with Ñāṇamoli, 1964, p. 182; eds katābhūmi); 135, 25 (ayaṃ ~i, so read with Ñāṇamoli, 1964, p. 182; eds katābhūmi); — akatāvi(n) , m ( fn )., who has not done (what was to be done) ; Peṭ 66, 9 (yaṃ ca ~ī brahmakāye upapajjati idaṃ phalaṃ); Th-a I 218, 17 .
